title: Pickle Bee Dee Bee
style: Quirky pop-funk with bouncy mid-tempo swing, snapped handclaps, rubbery bass, and bright guitar skanks; verse rides sparse drums and a humming synth pulse, pre-chorus tightens with rising chants and stacked claps, chorus pops open with gang vocals and a playful hook. Lead vocal stays cheeky and close-mic, with doubles on key phrases, call-and-response ad-libs, whistle fills, and a glossy punchy mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Court shoes on
Grip so clean
Green paddle flash
Like a lucky machine

You serve it low
I read the spin
Back line set
Let the fun begin

[Pre-Chorus]
One more bounce
Then I slide
Up to the kitchen
Clear-eyed

Soft hands ready
Watch me fold
When the tempo hits
I get bold

[Chorus]
Pickle bee dee bee
Pickle bee dee bee
Bee bop de da da
Bee bop de da da

Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle a pickle ball pro
Pickle a pickle ball pro

[Verse 2]
Toe on the line
Heart in the play
Dink by dink
I work my way

Crosscourt tease
Then drop it short
You reach too far
That’s my sport

Little laugh
Big control
I paint the line
And steal the soul

[Pre-Chorus]
One more bounce
Then I slide
Up to the kitchen
Clear-eyed

Soft hands ready
Watch me fold
When the tempo hits
I get bold

[Chorus]
Pickle bee dee bee
Pickle bee dee bee
Bee bop de da da
Bee bop de da da

Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle a pickle ball pro
Pickle a pickle ball pro

[Bridge]
Net tape trembling
Feet get light
I fake the heat
Then turn the bite

Soft touch, sharp move
Game on lock
One sweet drop
And the whole court stops

[Final Chorus]
Pickle bee dee bee
Pickle bee dee bee
Bee bop de da da
Bee bop de da da

Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle ball third shot drop shot
Pickle a pickle ball pro
Pickle a pickle ball pro

Pickle bee dee bee
Pickle bee dee bee
Pass me the win
I’m on the roll
